fact: In the four districts of the primary health care reform pilot (60 health centres and 6 hospitals), each health centre's nurse in charge was given a computer and submitted the monthly report electronically from the facility, and average monthly data completion at health centres was 94.2% in July 2016 to June 2017 (90.1% in July 2013 to June 2014), measured by the study from facility registers.
title: Effects of primary healthcare reform on routine health information systems (RHISs): a mixed-methods study in Lesotho
